outcome.Summary: Implemented cmd/report/main.go: run() parses --by (region|product) and --top N flags, reads the CSV header to locate required columns (error names any missing column), validates qty (integer ≥ 0) and price (≤2 decimals) per row with 1-based line numbers in errors, aggregates revenue in integer cents, sorts groups by revenue desc / name asc, prints group lines plus a TOTAL line over all rows. Added main_test.go covering the example, grouping, sorting/ties, --top, column reordering/extra columns, missing-column and bad-value errors, flag validation, cents arithmetic, and empty input. Verified `go vet ./... && go test ./...` passes and the CLI reproduces the spec's example output exactly.
